text:
Europe/Athens is UTC+2 and Europe/Paris is UTC+1 in August (both on DST in modern times, but historically time zones didn't exist in 1211; however, for the purpose of this exercise, we must use the given modern time zone conversion rule).  
Athens is 1 hour ahead of Paris.  
4 AM in Athens → 3 AM in Paris on the same date.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1211-08-06 03:00
